name: Heuristic Override Benchmark (HOB)
description: Large language models fail when a salient surface cue conflicts with an unstated feasibility constraint. We introduce the Heuristic Override Benchmark (HOB): 500 instances spanning 4 heuristic families and 5 constraint families, with minimal pairs and explicitness gradients. We pair HOB with a falsifiable behavioral characterization following a diagnose-measure-bridge-treat arc.
